summary: Automatic updates work again and wait safely for running jobs before they install.

fixes.title: Automatic updates install again
fixes.text: In 2.0.74 and 2.0.75 the update stopped safely before installing anything. It now waits for running jobs and then installs.
fixes.action: If your install is on 2.0.74 or 2.0.75, run the install once to get this release; later updates install by themselves.

fixes.title: Only this product's jobs are waited for
fixes.text: The update waits only for Entra Policy Suite's own jobs, never for another product's job in the same place.
